decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-11:** «trebuie să pot adăuga comentarii și pentru voluntari» — told that a volunteer has a single «Nota ta (doar organizatorii)» line, he chose «Ca la înscrieri»: the registrations' «Note interne», on each volunteer, for the organizers. That carries over the two asks of the same day on the registrations — the card first on the page and open when it holds a note, and a note from a row of the list.

**Decision.** A volunteer's single organizers' line (§754, `event_volunteers.note`, 500 characters, no author, no date) becomes the registrations' internal notes (§777, §785, and the first card and the row's control of «Note interne» first on the registration's page, and a note from a row of the list): several dated notes on each volunteer, each with its author.

1. **The table.** `event_volunteer_notes`: the volunteer (`ON DELETE CASCADE`, so «Șterge voluntarul», the thirty-day retention sweep and an event's hard delete take the notes with no code of their own), the author (`ON DELETE SET NULL`), the words (plain text, line breaks kept, at most 2000 characters — a registration note's own limit, one constant read by the forms, the service and the table's CHECK), when, and a soft-delete stamp. Migration `0196`, expand only.
2. **The carry.** The same migration gives every volunteer whose old line holds words one note with those words verbatim. Its author and moment come from the trail where the trail knows them: the latest `volunteer.edited` row of that volunteer, on that event, whose `fields` name `note` (matched by jsonb containment), gives the colleague and the moment; with none, the row's own creator and creation moment (a person the club typed with the line at the add); otherwise no author.
3. **The old column after the carry.** `event_volunteers.note` and its CHECK stay in the table and the schema, re-commented as kept until a contract release. New code neither writes nor shows it, with two exceptions that keep a promise true: «Șterge» on a note whose words equal the old line clears the line in the same transaction (the question says the words are gone, so they are); «Toate datele unei persoane» still prints the old line while no live note of that volunteer carries the same words (a line typed by the previous release between the migration and the new deployment).
4. **The forms.** «Nota ta (doar organizatorii)» leaves «Modifică»: the box, its parse, `STAFF_FIELDS`, the before/after diff and the update lose `note` together, so a save neither empties the old line nor audits a change nobody made. On «Adaugă un voluntar de mână» (the event card and the «Voluntari» list) the box stays, with the new limit, as the person's optional first note — written as a note of whoever adds, in the add's own transaction, with its own trail row, never into the old column; a box too long is refused on the box with every other box kept. The person's block no longer draws «Notă: …».
5. **Who.** Whoever manages the volunteers (`canManageVolunteers`: the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator) reads, counts, exports and adds — asserted in every function of `modules/volunteers/volunteer-notes.ts`, again in each action, and the pages ask first (BR-REQ-060-01). A note is deleted by its author or by whoever changes registrations (`canManageRegistrations`: the Administrator and above), as §777; a note with no author (carried, or its author's account removed) is therefore the Administrator's to delete. The delete empties the words and stamps the moment in one write; a second press is NOT_FOUND. The trail names who and when and never the words: `volunteer.note_added` / `volunteer.note_deleted`, entity `event`, the event's id, metadata `{ volunteerId }` and nothing else, as every `volunteer.*` row.
6. **The card.** The registrations' `NotesCard`, made generic in what tied it to a registration — the hidden field (`registrationId` or `volunteerId`), the limit, the words for an author nobody can name — stands first on the volunteer's page: after the heading block (the way back, the alert, the name with its state, the event's line) and before the person's block. It is open exactly when the volunteer has a live note, closed on «nicio notă» otherwise, and opens after its own save or delete and for `#note-interne`. Its presses (`admin/volunteers/[id]/note-actions.ts`) return a refusal as the form's own state with the words still in the box, and a success flashes the registrations' toast and comes back to the page at the card.
7. **The lists.** On «Voluntari», each row's name cell carries the marker with the count (one grouped count for the page's ids) linking to the person's card, and «Adaugă o notă» — the registrations list's own row control, a dialog over the list — whose press comes back to the same list address (filters, sort, page) through the volunteers' validated return. The event editor's «Voluntari» card reads one grouped count for its people too, and each person's folded row carries the marker linking to the person's page; the notes themselves are read there.
8. **The files.** The volunteers' CSV and both spreadsheets keep the column «Notă» where it was, under the same heading; its cell becomes the volunteer's live notes in a registration's cell format (§785): one note a line, newest first, `dd.mm.yyyy hh:mm · <the author's role>: <text>` on the club's clock (the files' other dates), the author a role and never a name, cut at a note's end below what Excel keeps with «… (mai multe note pe pagina voluntarului)». One grouped read per file — every event's workbook included. The formatter is shared, not copied: `exportNotesCell` and its limit moved to `shared/notes/note-text.ts`, generic in the role's key, beside the parse both kinds of note use.
9. **«Toate datele unei persoane».** Each volunteer offer lists its live notes — the words, the moment, the author's role, «autor necunoscut» where nobody can be named — and the access file's audit row counts them (`volunteerNotes`).
10. **Never elsewhere.** A volunteer's note is on the volunteer's page, counted on the two lists, in the volunteers' files and in the person's record; never on the public volunteers' list, in an email or on a badge. A structural guard (`tests/unit/volunteers/volunteer-notes-never-leave.test.ts`) lists the only files that may import the table or the service, as the registrations' guard does for theirs.

**Decided without the owner:** the limit (2000, the registrations' own, instead of the old line's 500 — every carried line fits); who deletes (the author or an Administrator, as on a registration, although an Organizer may delete a whole volunteer); the carry's author and moment (the trail's latest `note` edit, else the row's creator and creation, else nobody — never a guess); the words for a note with no author, «autor necunoscut» / «unknown author» (a carried line had none, and «cont șters» would claim an account was removed; a note whose author's account was removed reads the same, which is also true); that the add form keeps its box as the first note (an organizer who types a person often knows one thing about them) and that «Modifică» loses it; that the old column stays until a contract release, cleared only by deleting the note that carries its words; that the card stands first and opens when it holds a note, as on a registration's page; that the event card's rows carry the marker (one more grouped count, no query per row); that the files keep the heading «Notă» and its place (nothing that reads the files moves) and use the club's clock; the words reused from the registrations' notes wherever they are true of a volunteer («Note interne», the help line, the count, the question before a delete, the toasts, the refusals), new only for the closing line of a cut cell and the unknown author, and `volunteers.person.noteLabel` removed with the line it labelled. No new role predicate, no guide task, no row on /devs' growth card.

**For the lawyer.** The privacy notice's template already says, of a volunteer's offer, that the organizers may add a note of their own about it (singular). There are now several dated notes, each with the colleague who wrote it, read by the Organizer and the Administrators, written into the volunteers' files with the author as a role, and given on an access request with the author as a role. The template is not changed here (a changed template is announced to every Administrator and waits for approval); the plural, and whether to say that the notes are in the files, is the club's to word at its next revision of the notice. As on a registration, whether a note may be withheld from an access request where it would reveal another person's data (art. 15(4)) is the lawyer's question. A volunteer the club typed with no address is never found by «Toate datele unei persoane», which searches by address — that limit is unchanged.

**What the later contract release must do.** Carry what is left — every `event_volunteers.note` with words that no live note of that volunteer carries, as `0196` did — then drop the column and its CHECK `event_volunteers_note_length` in a migration with a `-- contract:` line naming this release; remove with it the two exceptions above (the clearing in `deleteVolunteerNote` and `volunteerOffers[].note` in the person's record).

**Refused.** Dropping the old column in this release (an expand and a contract in one migration, while the previous code still writes it); keeping the box on «Modifică» beside the notes (two places for the same words, and an edit that would rewrite history); editing a note (as §777: delete and write again); a query per row on either list; listing the notes inside the list's dialog; a filter or a search inside notes (as §777); a new column after «Notă» or a new heading (it would move every reader of the files); copying `exportNotesCell` or `NotesCard` for volunteers instead of sharing them; importing the registrations' notes module or table from the volunteers' module; the author's name in any file or in the person's record; a note on the public list, in an email, on a badge or on the race-day desk; a new role or predicate for a volunteer coordinator; touching the privacy notice's template or any legal text.
changelogLine: - **«Note interne» for volunteers** — several dated notes on each volunteer, each with its author: the card stands first on the volunteer's page and opens when it holds one, the «Voluntari» list and the event card count them and «Adaugă o notă» works from a row, the volunteers' files carry them in the «Notă» column with the author's role, and «Toate datele unei persoane» lists them; the old single note became the first one. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a volunteer's page, when an Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator opens it, then «Note interne» is the first card after the page's heading block and before the person's block, open exactly when the volunteer has a live note (closed with «nicio notă» otherwise, and open after its own save or delete and for `#note-interne`), listing the notes newest first with their author and moment («autor necunoscut» where nobody can be named), «Șterge» only on the notes the reader may delete, and a box of at most 2000 characters whose refusal keeps the words typed (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the «Voluntari» list and the event card's «Voluntari», when they are drawn, then each person with live notes carries the marker with the count, from one grouped count for the people shown, linking to the person's card; and every row of the list carries «Adaugă o notă», a dialog whose save comes back to the same list address (filters, sort, page) through the list's validated return with the toast «Nota a fost salvată», and whose refusal is said in the dialog with the words kept (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Adaugă un voluntar de mână» with «Nota ta (doar organizatorii)» filled, when it is saved, then the words are the person's first internal note, by whoever added them, in the add's own transaction, with its own `volunteer.note_added` row and nothing in `event_volunteers.note`; and given «Modifică», when it is saved, then it neither reads, writes nor audits a note — a save audits no `note` field and leaves the old column as it was (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given migration `0196`, when it runs, then every volunteer whose `event_volunteers.note` holds words gets exactly one note with those words verbatim, by the colleague and at the moment of the latest `volunteer.edited` row of that volunteer on that event naming `note`, else by the row's creator at its creation, else with no author; a volunteer with no line gets none; the old column and its CHECK are untouched; and deleting the note whose words equal the old line clears the line in the same transaction (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteers' file — one event's CSV or spreadsheet, or every event's spreadsheet — when it is downloaded, then the column «Notă» keeps its place and heading and each cell holds that volunteer's live notes, one a line, newest first, as «dd.mm.yyyy hh:mm · <the author's role>: <text>» on the club's clock, never a colleague's name, a deleted note left out, cut at a note's end below 32 000 characters with «… (mai multe note pe pagina voluntarului)», read in one grouped query per file (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer's internal notes, when each of the seven roles reads, counts, exports, adds or deletes one through the service, then only the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator are let through, every other role is refused FORBIDDEN by every function and never handed an empty list; a note is deleted only by its author or by an Administrator or above; the delete empties the words; and the trail rows `volunteer.note_added` / `volunteer.note_deleted` are entity `event` with `{ volunteerId }` and no word of the note (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer's internal notes, when «Toate datele unei persoane» is read or downloaded, then each volunteer offer lists its live notes with the words, the moment and the author's role (never a colleague's name), the old single line only while no live note carries the same words, and the download's audit row counts them as `volunteerNotes`; and no public page or route, email or badge imports or names the notes' table or service (2026-11-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Note interne» for volunteers: several dated notes, first on the volunteer's page, counted and added from the lists, in the files and the person's record
